### `entrypoints/lib/async.test.ts`

Covers: "createCoalescedAsyncRunner", "createSerialAsyncRunner", "createKeyedSerialRunner", "createKeyedCoalescer", "runConcurrentOperations".

### `entrypoints/lib/async.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `createCoalescedAsyncRunner(task)` | Wraps a task so calls during a run share it and trigger one rerun afterwards, rethrowing the first error once the runs settle. |
| `createKeyedSerialRunner(onError)` | Runs each key's tasks one at a time, each after that key's previous one settles; a failure is handed to the caller and to `onError`, and never holds up the tasks behind it. |
| `createSerialAsyncRunner(onError)` | A keyed serial runner with a single key. |
| `createKeyedCoalescer(enqueue, run, options)` | Keeps at most one run per key waiting in `enqueue`: a request for a key that is already waiting hands that run its newer value instead of queueing again, and a key run recently waits out `minIntervalMs` first, so a source firing constantly can neither flood a queue other work waits in nor keep it busy. |
| `concurrentFailures(items, operation)` | Runs `operation` on every item at once and, once all settle, gives the reasons those that failed threw. |
| `runConcurrentOperations(items, operation, failureMessage)` | Runs an operation on every item concurrently and, once all settle, throws an AggregateError with the given message if any failed. |
| `withNamedAsyncLock(name, task)` | Runs a task while holding the named Web Lock, so contexts sharing the name run it one at a time, or runs it directly without lock support. |
| `followedBy(task, after)` | `task`, calling `after` each time a run of it resolves. |

### `entrypoints/lib/bookmarks.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `openableSpace(spaces, spaceId)` | The space a window may switch to, failing for a space removed or archived. |
| `shownSpaces(spaces)` | The spaces a window can show, in pagination order: every space not archived. |
| `archivedSpaces(spaces)` | The spaces marked archived, which a window hides from pagination until they return. |
| `neighbourShownSpace(spaces, spaceId)` | The shown space that takes over from `spaceId` when it leaves pagination: the next one, else the previous. |
| `preferredActiveSpaceId(spaces, storedSpaceId, currentSpaceId)` | The space a window should show: the stored space if it still exists, else the current one, else the first space, or null without spaces. |
| `parseBookmarkTitle(rawTitle)` | Splits a raw bookmark title into its visible title and the trailing JSON metadata object Hyper appends, or empty metadata when there is none. |
| `serializeBookmarkTitle(title, metadata)` | A raw bookmark title with the metadata appended as compact JSON, dropping undefined values and empty nested records. |
| `visibleBookmarkTitle(node)` | A node's title as users see it, without the metadata Hyper stores in the bookmark title. |
| `childFoldersTitled(parent, title)` | A node's child folders whose visible title is `title`. |
| `isFolderTitled(node, title)` | Whether a node is a folder whose visible title is exactly the given title. |
| `isBookmarkSeparator(node)` | Whether a bookmark node is a browser separator rather than a bookmark or folder. |
| `isBookmarkFolder(node)` | Whether a node is a folder: it has no URL and is not a separator. |
| `bookmarkFolderIds(nodes)` | The IDs of every folder in the given nodes and their nested folders, depth first. |
| `bookmarkFolderIdsContainingUrls(nodes, urls)` | The IDs of folders that directly or through a subfolder hold a bookmark for any of the given pages, so they can be expanded. |
| `bookmarkFolderOptions(nodes, excludedRootIds, parentPath)` | Every folder outside the excluded roots as a choice with its visible title and slash-joined path, skipping the browser's invisible root. |
| `bookmarkTitleWithCustomName(node, title)` | A node's raw title renamed to the given visible title and marked as a custom name, so page title updates leave it alone. |
| `customBookmarkTitleMatches(node, title)` | Whether a node carries a custom name equal to the given title once trimmed. |
| `hyperRecord(metadata)` | The hyper record inside parsed title metadata, or an empty record when it is absent or not an object. |
| `bookmarkHyperMetadata(node)` | The `hyper` metadata a node's title carries. |
| `hyperField(isType)` | A reader for one `hyper` metadata field, answering it only when `isType` accepts it. |
| `bookmarkTitleWithHyper(title, hyper, { metadata, visible })` | A title with its `hyper` metadata patched, an `undefined` value removing a key. `metadata` patches the top-level metadata beside it, and `visible` replaces the visible title. |
| `lastActiveTabTokensByWindow(node)` | The per-window record of last active tab tokens on a space folder's title, or undefined when it has none. |
| `spaceLastActiveTabToken(node, windowId)` | The token of the tab last active in a space, for the given window when recorded, else the space's window-independent token. |
| `spaceBookmarkTitleWithLastActiveTabToken(node, token, windowId)` | A space folder's title recording the token of its last active tab, both overall and for the given window. |
| `spaceBookmarkTitleWithoutColour(node)` | A space folder's title without the colour earlier versions kept on it. A space's colour is now only ever its tab groups' colour. |
| `spaceBookmarkArchived(node)` | Whether a space folder's title marks it archived. |
| `spaceBookmarkTitleWithArchived(node, archived)` | A space folder's title marked archived, or with the archived flag removed when restoring it. |
| `spaceBookmarkTitleWithMigratedLastActiveTabWindowIds(node, previousToCurrentWindowIds)` | A space folder's title with per-window last active tab tokens rekeyed from previous to current window IDs, unchanged if nothing moved. |

| `isSpaceBookmarksFolder(node)` | Whether a node is a space's marked bookmarks folder, which holds the space's saved bookmarks. |
| `isTabFolder(node)` | Whether a node is a folder marked as a user tab folder inside a space's tabs tree. |
| `isLegacyWindowFolder(node)` | A window folder an earlier layout kept a window's tab backings in. |

| `isLocalBookmarkNode(node)` | Whether a node is a saved bookmark or ordinary folder owned by a space, rather than a tab backing or structural folder. |

| `bookmarkCustomName(node)` | A name the user gave a bookmark or tab, rather than one following its page. |
| `bookmarkTitleWithoutCustomName(node, pageTitle)` | A bookmark follows its page again, showing `pageTitle` if known and its current title until then. |
| `tabBackingPageTitle(node)` | The title a tab's page gives itself, as its backing keeps it: shown, or beside a user-given name. |
| `tabBackingTitleWithName(node, name)` | A tab backing's title showing the user's custom name, keeping the page's own title in metadata to return to. |
| `tabBackingTitleWithoutName(node, fallback)` | A backing shows its page's own title again; `fallback` stands in if that was never kept. |
| `tabBackingBookmarkLink(node)` | The linked and declined bookmark IDs a tab backing's title records, omitting whichever are absent. |
| `tabBackingTitleWithBookmarkLink(title, link)` | A tab backing's title with its linked and declined bookmark IDs replaced, removing either one left undefined. |
| `tabBackingTitleLeavingDomain(title)` | A tab that moves to another site leaves its name and bookmark link behind. |
| `nestedTabBackings(nodes)` | Every tab backing among the nodes, flattened out of tab folders and legacy window folders. |
| `tabBackings(space)` | The tab backing bookmarks among a space's children, excluding its saved bookmarks. |
| `spaceHasTabUrl(space, url, spaceIdsByPageIdentity)` | Whether a space has an open tab for the URL's page, using the page identity index when given, else the space's tab backings. |
| `bookmarkNodesHaveUrl(nodes, url)` | Whether any of the nodes is a bookmark for the same page as the URL. |

| `bestTabFaviconUrl(tabs)` | The favicon of the active tab among the tabs, else of the first tab that has one, or undefined. |

| `findHyperBookmarkStructure(tree)` | The hyper root with its favourites, spaces, and optional global bookmarks folders, or null when the root or a required folder is missing. |

| `buildNodeMap(tree)` | Every node in the tree by its ID, for constant-time lookups. |

| `filterBookmarkTree(nodes, query)` | The tree pruned to bookmarks and folders whose visible title or URL contains the query, keeping folders that hold matches. |
| `containsNode(node, nodeId)` | Whether the node with the ID is a descendant of the given node. |
| `findBookmarkPathByUrl(nodes, url)` | The chain of nodes from the given roots down to the first bookmark for the URL's page, or null when none matches. |
| `bookmarkNodeIdForPage(nodes, identity, selectedNodeId)` | The ID of the bookmark for a page, preferring the selected node when it matches, else the first match in the tree. |

| `deriveWindowSpaceTabTree(tree, activeSpaceId, liveBackingIds)` | The active space's tabs folder ID and its tab folders and live tab backings, dropping backings of tabs no longer open. |
| `descendantCount(node)` | The number of bookmarks inside a folder at any depth, not counting the folders. |
| `descendantItemCount(node)` | The number of bookmarks and folders inside a node at any depth. |
| `bookmarkCount(nodes)` | Bookmarks among the nodes and inside their folders, not counting the folders. |

| `indexTabsByPageIdentity(tabs)` | The tabs grouped by the identity of the page each one shows, skipping tabs without one. |
| `indexTabSpacesByPageIdentity(tabs, tabSpaceIds)` | The IDs of the spaces each page is open in, by page identity, from the tabs and their recorded spaces. |

| `preferredSpaceForPage(url, activeSpaceId, spaces, spaceIdsByPageIdentity)` | The space opening a page should use: the space it is already open in, preferring the active one, else the active space. |

| `isTabSleeping(tab)` | Whether a tab is discarded or frozen by the browser to save resources. |
| `bookmarkTabStatus(tabsByPageIdentity, url)` | The open tabs for a bookmark's page, and whether they are all sleeping or any is active. |
| `summariseBookmarkFolders(folders, tabsByPageIdentity)` | Counts each folder's bookmarks and notes whether any is open, visiting every node once, so nested folders shown together do not each re-walk their subtree. |

| `writeHyperPreferences(next)` | Writers read and rewrite the one root title, so a second must wait for the first. |

| `ensureSpaceBookmarksFolder(spaceId)` | A space's marked bookmarks folder, created or repaired when needed, which holds its saved bookmarks. |
| `tabTreeContents(tabsFolder)` | Reads the whole tabs tree once, then walks it in order. |

| `spaceTabsFolders(spaceId)` | The marked tabs folders directly inside a space folder. |
| `backingsIn(tabsFolders)` | Every backing in the tab trees under these Tabs folders, in order. |

| `renameTabFolder(folderId, title)` | Renames a tab folder that sits in a space's tab tree to the trimmed title, keeping its metadata and rejecting blank titles. |

Given a window, as the bin does, the folder's tabs in that window close, and whatever else it held (other windows' and sessions' tabs, parked tabs) moves up to where it was, so nothing the window did not show is lost. |

| `allTabBackings()` | Every tab backing in every space's tab tree, in space and tree order. |
| `installationInOpenWindows()` | The installation whose backings name this browser's open windows, which no other device can. |
| `installationStartedAt(local, backings)` | When this installation began, read from local storage or estimated from its oldest backing and then stored. |
| `predecessorInstallation(local, backings)` | The installation this one replaced: the latest whose backings all predate it. Reinstalling starts a new installation, while another device in use goes on adding backings after this one began. |
| `parkedTabBackings(spaceId)` | A space's local backings without an open window, plus windowless ones a replaced installation left for pages not already backed here. |
| `hasParkedTabBackings(spaceId)` | Whether a space has parked backings waiting to be restored when it opens in a window. |
| `openWindowBackingPageCounts()` | How many of this installation's backings in still-open windows hold each page, by page identity. |

| `backingSpaceId(backing)` | The space whose tabs hold a backing, through any folders, earlier layouts' window folders included. |
| `keptBacking(backingId)` | A tab backing with its URL and the space whose tab tree holds it, failing when it is no longer kept in a space. |
| `sessionBackingPage(backingId)` | The page another session keeps a tab of, as a bookmark of it would name it. |
| `copyBackingToSession(backingId, sessionInstallationId)` | Keeps a copy of a backing's tab for another session, beside it and parked until that session opens the space. |

| `bookmarkById(id)` | The node with this ID, or nothing if there is none. |

| `removeTabBackingBookmark(location)` | Removes a tab's backing only when it still matches the recorded location, by exact ID or else by token or page in the space. |

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `spaceKey(windowId, spaceId)` | The registry key joining a window ID and space ID, so each space in each window owns at most one group. |

| `groupOwnerships(registry)` | Every group ownership in the registry as a list. |
| `groupIdForSpace(registry, windowId, spaceId)` | The tab group ID owned by this space in this window, or undefined when it owns none. |

| `adoptGroup(registry, ownership)` | Adoption is the only way a group becomes a Hyper group. It displaces both the previous group for that space and the previous space for that group, so the registry cannot be driven into an ambiguous state by repeated adoption. |
| `unadoptGroup(registry, groupId)` | A new registry without the ownership of this tab group, leaving the group unowned by any space. |
| `migrateGroup(registry, previousGroupId, next)` | Chromium reissues a group id when its tabs move to another window. The space keeps its group only if the destination window has no group of its own for that space; otherwise the stale mapping is dropped rather than displacing a mapping that matches a real group. |
| `toSpaceGroupIdsByWindow(registry)` | Flattens the registry into group IDs keyed by window ID and then space ID. |

### `entrypoints/lib/modelClient.test.ts`

Covers: "createHyperModelClient".

### `entrypoints/lib/modelClient.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `modelClientSearch(client)` | Keeps a view callback bound to its current authenticated model connection. |
| `defaultConnect(name)` | Opens a runtime port with this name to the background model. |
| `defaultSchedule(run, delayMs)` | Runs a callback after a delay with setTimeout and returns a function that cancels it. |
| `createHyperModelClient(options)` | The view side of the model port. It owns the transport only: handshake, acknowledgement, reconnection, and intent correlation. It derives nothing and decides nothing, so a view can never disagree with the background about what the browser currently looks like. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `checkWorkerBuild(workerBuildId)` | A worker from before build ids states none, which is also another build. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `send(active, message)` | Chrome can close a port before its onDisconnect is delivered, and posting to it then throws. That is the same drop, so it is handled as one. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `whenConnected(timeoutMs)` | Resolves true once the client is connected, or false if it is refused, disposed, or still not connected after `timeoutMs`. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `sendIntent(kind, payload, suppliedCommandId, onSent, attempts)` | A user's choice made while the background worker is waking (it sleeps when idle) has never been sent, so it waits for the connection instead of being dropped; dropping it is a click that silently does nothing. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `sendSearch(request, attempts)` | A search only reads, so one Chrome refused to send is sent again like an intent. |

A client proves its extension-page role, is issued an identity by the background rather than claiming one, and then receives exactly one unacknowledged delivery at a time so a wedged view cannot make the background queue snapshots without bound. |

| --- | --- |
| `mergeNavigationUpdates(waiting, next)` | Folds a newer navigation into one still waiting: it ends where the newer does, but began where the waiting one did. |
| `createNavigationUpdateQueue(enqueue, run)` | Hands each tab's navigations to `run` through `enqueue`, folding those that pile up meanwhile into one. A page that only rewrites its fragment, as some do nonstop, is also held to one update per `FRAGMENT_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS`. |
| `tabShows(tab, url)` | Whether the tab's current URL is the same navigation target as the given URL. |

| `createNavigationDedupe(dependencies)` | Keeps one tab per page in a space and window: a tab that navigates to, or opens, a page its space already shows hands focus to the existing tab and is sent back or closed. Every step re-reads both tabs, so any change the user makes meanwhile wins over the dedupe. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `keptDuplicate(tabId, identity)` | Whether the user chose to keep this tab on this page; showing any other page ends that choice. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `cancelDedupe(pending, sourceIndex)` | Cancels a dedupe: the source tab makes the navigation it was taken back from, or, if it was closed, opens again where it was. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `offerCancel(pending, sourceIndex, title)` | Deduping is a best guess the user can cancel (build spec §27 case b). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `closeSourceAfterBack(tabId, pendingBack)` | Closes the source once its back navigation has settled, if nothing has moved on. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `focusExistingSameSpaceNavigation(tabId, url, generation, previousUrl, newTabNavigation)` | A tab that navigated to a page its space already shows goes back, and the existing tab takes focus. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `closeNewlyGroupedDuplicate(tabId, confirmedNavigation, activeAtCreation)` | A new tab opened on a page its space already shows closes, and the existing tab takes focus. |

### `entrypoints/lib/operationJournal.test.ts`

Covers: "durable operation journal".

### `entrypoints/lib/operationJournal.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `isOperationKind(value)` | Whether a stored value names one of the known durable operation kinds, such as space deletion or tab moves. |
| `isOperationPhase(value)` | Whether a stored value is a valid durable operation phase: prepared, effect-applied or verifying. |
| `isStringRecord(value)` | Whether a value is a record whose entries are all strings, numbers or booleans, as completion proofs require. |
| `parseOperation(value)` | The live or abandoned durable operation a stored journal entry describes, or undefined when any field is malformed. |
| `isAbandonedOperation(operation)` | Whether a journaled operation has been abandoned rather than still awaiting recovery. |
| `retainOperations(operations)` | Only abandoned records are ever evicted. Live records stay until they are resolved; their bound is enforced when an operation is admitted, so the journal can never silently forget work it is still responsible for. |
| `replaceLiveOperation(id, replace, unavailable)` | Rewrites one live operation; a gone or abandoned one is left to `unavailable`. |
| `beginDurableOperation(operation)` | Journals a prepared operation before its first effect, refusing duplicates of a live idempotency key or too many live operations. |
| `advanceDurableOperation(id, phase, updates)` | Moves a live journaled operation to a later phase with optional proof or payload updates, throwing if it was abandoned or is missing. |
| `completeDurableOperation(id)` | Removes a finished operation from the durable journal so it is no longer recovered. |
| `abandonDurableOperation(id, recoveryReason)` | Marks a live journaled operation abandoned in the verifying phase, recording when and why recovery gave up. |
| `recoverDurableOperations(resolve)` | Recovery implementations must verify the recorded completion proof before completing an operation. They may roll back only entities named in the journal; otherwise the operation stays as an auditable abandonment record. |

| `retainRecentEntries(entries, limit)` | Lifecycle bookkeeping outlives the tab or group it describes, so it would otherwise grow for as long as the worker lives. Insertion order makes the oldest entries the ones whose work has long since settled, and an evicted entry reads as a stale generation rather than a current one. |

| `pendingTabOperationIsCurrent(pendingOperations, operationId, expectedOperation, generations, expectedGenerations)` | Whether a pending tab operation is still the one registered under its ID and every tab it captured keeps its generation. |
| `tabDisplayTitle(tab, fallback)` | The title shown for a tab: its trimmed title, else its pending or current URL, else the fallback text. |

| `tabVisibleBookmarkState(bookmark, tabUrl)` | Whether a tab shows no bookmark, its bookmark, or a bookmark it could update because the tab has navigated to another URL. |

| `spaceTabActivationTarget(tabs, ownerships, backingToken, preferActive)` | The tab to activate when showing a space: the active one when preferred, else the token's tab, else a live tab, else the first. |
| `focusTabInWindow(tabId, targetWindowId, sourceWindowId, api, canFocusWindow)` | Activates a tab and focuses its window when it differs, restoring the previous active tab and reporting false when focus is no longer allowed. |
| `closeTabOrWindow(tabId, windowId, api)` | Closes a tab, or its whole window when it is the last tab there, and throws if the tab is still open afterwards. |
| `closeTabsConcurrently(tabIds, closeTab)` | Closes each distinct tab at once through the given closer, waiting for all before rethrowing the first failure. |
| `canCloseOtherTab(tab, condition)` | Whether a tab may close under Close other tabs: identified, not the kept tab, in that window, and neither pinned nor active. |
| `closeOtherTabsConditionally(tabIds, condition, getTab, closeTab)` | Re-reads each target directly before closing it so a stale view cannot close a newly active tab. |
| `moveTabsPreservingActive(tabIds, windowId, index, api, shouldContinue, effects)` | Moves tabs to an index in a window under the optional effect fence, then reactivates the previously active tab unless the user changed it. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `move()` | The move is fenced against the tabs it reorders: external changes since admission supersede the plan, while Hyper's own move event is declared. |
| `tabsInBrowsingContext(tabs, incognito)` | The tabs in the same private or normal browsing context, so tabs are never matched across incognito boundaries. |
| `recentOpenTabs(tabs, windowId, extensionOrigin, limit)` | The window's most recently accessed inactive tabs outside Hyper's own pages, newest first and limited in number. |
| `spaceRestoreCandidates(tabs, ownerships, options)` | The window's tabs a space restore may take: those in the restored group, else those the space owns plus unowned unpinned ones when claiming. |
| `unroutedTabIds(tabs, ownerships, extensionOrigin)` | Tabs no space owns yet; pinned tabs and Hyper's own pages never join one. |
| `unplacedTabIds(tabs, ownerships, extensionOrigin)` | Tabs the background has yet to place in this window: unrouted ones, and ones that arrived from another window (a tab dragged out) whose ownership still names the window they left. |
| `isCurrentSpaceRestoreCandidate(tab, windowId, candidateTabIds, groupId)` | Whether a tab is still a restore candidate: in the window, chosen or in the restored group, and neither pinned nor private. |
| `tabSnapshotKey(tabs)` | A string key of each tab's ID, group, discarded state and URL in ID order, so polls can tell when the tab set changes. |
| `waitForRestoredTabGroup(queryTabs, findGroup, options)` | Polls the tabs until a restored group is found, the timeout passes, the wait is cancelled or nothing is still awaited. |
| `resolveSpaceRestoreGroup(initialTabs, findGroup, queryTabs, options)` | Finds a space's restored tab group, waiting for the browser to bring it back when recovering, and reports whether the restore can proceed. |
| `waitForStableTabSnapshot(queryTabs, options)` | Polls the tabs until their snapshot stays unchanged for a quiet period, then returns the latest tabs, also stopping on timeout or cancellation. |
| `canSyncBookmarkTitleFromTab(tab)` | Whether a tab's title may be written to a bookmark, which is never so for private tabs. |
| `bookmarkTitleForTab(tab, url)` | The title to give a bookmark for a tab: its title when it may sync, else the URL. |
| `bareAddress(value)` | An address lowercased, decoded and stripped of scheme, leading www and trailing slash, for comparing placeholder titles with URLs. |
| `isPlaceholderTabTitle(title, url)` | A title the browser makes up when the page has given none, such as while it loads, sleeps or fails to load: blank, the address, or just the host. |
| `comparablePageUrl(value)` | A lowercase URL without query, fragment or trailing slash, used to recognise new tab and blank pages. |
| `sameNavigationUrl(left, right)` | Whether two addresses parse to the same exact URL, falling back to string equality when either is not a valid URL. |
| `restoredTabCleanupPlan(tabs, candidateTabIds, hyperNewTabUrl)` | Which restored blank candidate tabs can be removed, and whether a replacement tab is needed so the window is not left empty. |
| `cleanupRestoredTabsInWindow(windowId, candidateTabGenerations, hyperNewTabUrl, api, currentGeneration, onReplacementCreated)` | Removes still-current blank tabs left by a restore in a window, first creating a replacement tab when they are all the window holds. |
| `isBlankTabPage(url, hyperNewTabUrl)` | Whether an address is Hyper's new tab page or a browser blank or new tab page. |
| `isTabUnloaded(tab)` | Whether a tab holds no page now, being discarded or not yet loaded since a restore, so it loads its page afresh when shown. A frozen tab still holds its page, which showing it does not refresh. |
| `isHistoryNavigationCommit(details, tabId)` | Whether a navigation commit is a back or forward navigation in this tab's top frame. |
| `findReusableTab(tabs, identity, context, scope)` | A tab in the same browsing context, and window when scoped, already showing this page, preferring the active then a live tab. |
| `findTabTargetSpace(spaces, options)` | The space a tab goes to: the fallback space, else its current one, else the active space when unmatched tabs join it. |

### `entrypoints/sidepanel/hooks/useBrowserState.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `useBrowserState()` | React hook. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `releaseSettlementWaiters()` | A dropped connection leaves a command's fate unknown, so its caller is told only that the change was not seen through. The model stays authoritative for what actually happened. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `reproject()` | Rebuilds view state from the last committed projection with the still pending edits laid over it. Re-deriving from the projection each time is what keeps an optimistic edit from outliving the change that justified it. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `settleLoading()` | The sidebar draws its bookmarks from the model, so it stays in its loading state until the opening commit arrives. Revision zero is the model before it has read the browser, and rendering it would show an empty profile. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `submitIntentForOutcome(kind, payload, optimistic, options)` | Sends a change as an intent and shows it immediately. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `submitIntentForResult(kind, payload, parse)` | Waits for the effect and returns what it created, or undefined if it failed. |

| `everyNode(nodes, rootId)` | Every node in the tree flattened as if all folders were expanded, so copied items can be found anywhere. |

| `tabEntry(tab, title, backing)` | The clipboard entry for an open tab, with its title, URL, tab ID and any backing bookmark's ID and metadata. |
| `bookmarkEntry(node, favourite)` | The clipboard entry for a bookmark, or a folder with its children copied recursively, keeping IDs, metadata and the favourite flag. |

| `hyperClipboard(operation, items, surroundings)` | The Hyper clipboard payload for a copy or cut of the selected items, tagged with this installation and window. |
| `resolveClipboard(clipboard, surroundings)` | The rows a copy names, if every one is still here as it was copied. Only a copy this installation made is trusted to name its items, since any page can write the clipboard. A tab must also be one of this window's: other windows' tabs never reach a view (DECISIONS 16). |
| `itemLocator(surroundings)` | Finds the rows entries name: the ones still here as they were described. |
| `searchItemEntry(item)` | A search result described as a clipboard entry, which can then find its row. |
| `placeOf({ ancestorIds, depth, index, nodeId, parentId })` | Where a row sits, as drag data names it. |
| `folderPlace(folder)` | A folder's place in the tree together with its visible title, or Untitled folder, for a drop target. |
| `folderDrop(items, folder, modifierActive, target, from, invalid)` | Dropping `items` on the middle of `folder`, first inside it, unless `from` is already there. |
| `bookmarkFolderDrop(items, folder, modifierActive, nodeMap)` | The drop request for pasting items into a bookmark folder, refusing a folder into itself or an unbookmarkable tab. |
| `tabFolderDrop(items, folder, modifierActive)` | The drop request for pasting items into a tab folder, refusing a tab folder into itself or its descendants. |
| `planPaste(contents, target, surroundings)` | What pasting does on a folder: what dropping the copied rows on its middle would, holding the copy modifier when they were copied rather than cut. Where a drop would move the original even so, a copy pastes copies instead: tabs open again as new tabs, and folders, which Hyper cannot duplicate, paste only when cut. |
| `planSessionPaste(items, installationId, copying)` | Pasting on another session gives it the tabs copied or cut, as dropping them on its section would: this window's tabs that Hyper keeps, and other sessions' tabs. A session keeps only tabs, so bookmarks and addresses stay where they are. |
| `planFavouritePaste(items, pages, index, copying, surroundings)` | Pasting on a favourites bar slot pins what was copied there, as dropping it on the slot would. An address pins as a new favourite. |

The bar still shows the most recent tabs: one that drops out, by closing or by a newer tab arriving, leaves its place to the newcomer, and every other tile stays put. |

Tiles shrink to `MIN_TILE` to keep the seven slots and the button, then the bar drops a column at a time; where wider, it adds one each time another fits at `MIN_EXTRA_TILE`. |
| `unpinnedSlotCount(favourites, slotCount)` | How many of the favourite bar's slots hold no favourite and are free for recent tabs. |

| `groupFavourites(group)` | The favourites a grouped tile stands for, in slot order. |

| `domainGroups({ favourites, recent, slotCount, tabBookmarkIds })` | Gathers the bar by domain. Favourites on one domain merge into the tile of the left-most, and take this window's tabs of that domain; a tab opened from a favourite stays with it even once it wanders. Other tabs gather into one group per domain, ordered by their most recent tab. |
| `groupedFavouriteBarSlots(pinned, recent, slotCount)` | The grouped bar's slots: each favourite group in the slot of its left-most favourite, and recent groups filling every other slot, including those of favourites merged into another tile. |

| `parseResult(result, valid)` | An intent's result as `Value`, when it is an object that `valid` accepts. |

| `createSettledIntentSubmitter(submitIntent)` | Submits an intent, optionally shown at once, and fails with `errorMessage` unless it settles successfully. |
| `createSpaceSelectionAdmitter(client, settlement)` | Resolves once the model admits a space choice, carrying whether it later succeeded. |
| `createBrowserFeatureIntentSubmitters(submitSettledIntent)` | Submitters for page-content access and tab media playback intents, each with the message shown when it fails. |
| `createBrowserCommandSubmitter(closeTabs, runBackingOperation, submitSettledIntent)` | A submitter for browser command intents that closes tabs directly and runs other commands as tracked settled intents. |
| `createBookmarkCreationSubmitters(submitIntentForResult)` | Bookmarks the view asks for; each answers with the node it made, and a favourite takes its slot in the same intent. |
| `createTabFolderIntentSubmitters(submitIntent, submitIntentForResult)` | Submitters that create, rename, remove and move tab folders and tab tree nodes through the setTabFolder intent. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `createTabFolder(spaceId, parentId)` | Creating a folder answers with the node, because the caller opens it for renaming straight away. The result arrives on the revision that already contains the folder, so the view never names an entity it cannot yet see. |
| `optimisticDestination(tree, move)` | Where a move shows at once; a step resolves against the tree it is laid over, as the background resolves it. |
| `selectionOverlay(kind, items)` | Moves and deletions show at once, held against their command until it settles. |
| `createBookmarkEditSubmitters(submitIntentForOutcome)` | Bookmark edits the view asks for. A dropped selection goes as one intent carrying every item, so the view waits for one outcome rather than sequencing an intent per item. |
| `createCrossWindowIntentSubmitters(runBackingOperation, submitSettledIntent)` | What a sidebar asks of other windows: their tabs, and drags it shares with them or takes from them. |
| `createSplitViewIntentSubmitter(runBackingOperation, submitSettledIntent)` | A submitter that shows a tab beside another tab or a new page in the browser's split view. |
| `createSpaceIntentSubmitters(spacesFolderId, runBackingOperation, submitIntentForResult, submitSettledIntent, submitIntentForOutcome)` | What a sidebar asks of a whole space: a new one, a copy of one, and this window's tabs in one. |
| `createSpaceArchiveSubmitter(runBackingOperation, submitIntentForOutcome)` | Archives or unarchives a space, placed before `beforeSpaceId` or last. The flag and move show at once, held against the command until it settles. |
| `searchSelectionIntents(submit)` | Search picks only tune later searches, so each waits for its own settlement and no view state. |
| `timedMessageIntents(submitIntent)` | The window's timed message is model state, so the view only names it and the background acts. |

## scripts

### `scripts/generateIndex.ts`

Writes INDEX.md: every file in the repository, its functions and what each one is responsible for, read from the source's own doc comments.

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `trackedFiles()` | Every file git knows about or would add, sorted by path, leaving out the index itself. |
| `isTestFile(path)` | Whether a path is a unit test, e2e spec or benchmark, which are indexed by what they cover. |
| `oneLine(text)` | Flattens comment prose onto one line and reduces `X` to `X`. |
| `shorten(text)` | Keeps a description to its first paragraph, cut at a sentence end when it runs long. |
| `cellText(text)` | Escapes text for a Markdown table cell. |
| `isJsDoc(comment)` | Whether a comment is a JSDoc block rather than a plain comment. |
| `jsDocProse(comment)` | The prose of a JSDoc block, without its stars or its `@tag` lines. |
| `isToolingComment(text)` | Whether a `//` comment is a lint, type or formatter directive rather than prose. |
| `describeNode(node)` | The doc comment directly above a node: its JSDoc block, or else the run of `//` lines that ends on the line before it. |
| `patternName(pattern)` | A readable name for a parameter, including destructured, defaulted and rest parameters. |
| `parameterList(parameters)` | The comma-separated parameter names shown in a function signature. |
| `functionInitializer(expression)` | The function a `const` holds, looking through wrappers such as `memo(...)` and `forwardRef(...)`. |
| `fallbackDescription(name, path)` | A generic description for undocumented React components and hooks. |
| `memberName(key)` | The name of a class member key. |
| `collectFunctions(statements, path, depth, entries)` | Collects named functions in a body: top level always, nested ones only when documented. |
| `moduleSummary(program)` | A doc comment at the top of the file that belongs to the module rather than its first declaration. |
| `calleeName(callee)` | The dotted name of a call target, such as `test.describe` for `test.describe.serial(...)`. |
| `titleOf(call, source)` | The title passed as the first argument to a `describe` or test call. |
| `testTitles(program, source)` | Top-level `describe` titles, or the test titles themselves when a file has no describe blocks. |
| `markdownTitle(text)` | The first top-level heading of a Markdown file. |
| `describeFile(path)` | Parses one file into its summary, its functions or, for tests, the behaviour it covers. |
| `folderOf(path)` | The folder a path sits in, with `.` for the repository root. |
| `folderTitle(folder)` | The heading shown for a folder. |
| `anchorFor(heading)` | The GitHub Markdown anchor for a heading. |
| `renderFile(file)` | The Markdown section for one file. |
| `render(files)` | The whole index: header, folder list and one section per file. |
| `sidecarEntry(value)` | A stored sidecar entry in its current shape, upgrading a bare description string so an entry added that way is kept rather than dropped as stale. |
| `applySidecar(files)` | Fills undocumented functions from the sidecar and drops sidecar entries that no longer match an undocumented function, so it never drifts from the code. |

## tests/e2e/fixtures

### `tests/e2e/fixtures/activation.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `activationFingerprint(context, sessionPrefix)` | A signature of everything space activation moves: tab order, grouping, focus, group collapse, and the session state that decides which space owns a tab. |
| `waitForActivationQuiescence(context, budgetMs)` | Waits for space activation to stop moving rather than guessing how long it takes. |

### `tests/e2e/fixtures/activeSpace.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `windowSpace(worker, windowId, operation, spaceId)` | Reads, writes or forgets a window's active space in one worker call, through the window value where the browser has one and session storage otherwise. |
| `readActiveSpaceId(worker, windowId)` | Binds the end-to-end suite to the production storage contract. Reading the key through this helper means a change to where the active space lives fails to compile here, instead of silently reading a key nothing writes any more. |
| `seedActiveSpaceId(worker, windowId, spaceId)` | Stores the given space as the window's active space in the background, so a test can start from a known space. |
| `clearActiveSpaceId(worker, windowId)` | Forgets a window's space, as a browser restart or extension reload does. |

### `tests/e2e/fixtures/localBookmarks.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `localBookmarksRootIds(worker, spaceIds)` | Binds the end-to-end suite to the production local-bookmark contract. Seeding through these helpers puts fixtures in the same root the extension writes to, so a seeded bookmark cannot be parked where the sidebar will never show it. |
| `localBookmarksRootId(worker, spaceId)` | Polls until the space has a local bookmarks root folder and returns its bookmark ID, failing if it never appears. |

### `tests/e2e/fixtures/preferences.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `bookmarkTree(worker)` | The whole browser bookmark tree as the service worker's bookmarks.getTree reports it. |
| `readHyperPreferences(worker)` | Reads Hyper's preferences back from the hyper root bookmark folder, so tests can assert what was persisted. |
| `saveHyperPreference(worker, key, value)` | Binds the end-to-end suite to the production preference contract. The helper writes the root folder title exactly as Hyper does, which is also how a preference arrives from another device through sync. |

## tests/e2e/helpers

### `tests/e2e/helpers/chrome.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `callChrome(worker, method, ...args)` | Calls one extension API method in the service worker, such as `callChrome(worker, 'tabs.update', tabId, { active: true })`, and returns its result. |
| `visibleTitle(title)` | A bookmark title without Hyper's trailing metadata. |
| `bookmarkParentId(worker, id)` | The parent folder ID of the bookmark with this ID, or undefined when it has no parent or no longer exists. |
| `bookmarkTitle(worker, id)` | The raw stored title of the bookmark with this ID, including any metadata, or undefined when it is missing. |
| `firstSpaceId(worker)` | The first space under the bar's `hyper/spaces`, once the extension has created it. |
| `bookmarkDescendants(nodes)` | The nodes and all their descendants, depth-first in tree order. |
| `allBookmarks(worker)` | Every bookmark node, depth-first in tree order, from one `getTree` call. |
| `bookmarkChildren(worker, parentId)` | The direct child bookmarks and folders of the given bookmark folder, in their stored order. |
| `seedBookmarks(worker, seeds, parentId)` | Creates the seeds depth first under `parentId`, else Chrome's bookmark bar, in one evaluation, and returns the IDs of the keyed nodes. |
| `hyperSeed({ bookmarks, favourites, globalBookmarks, space, tabs })` | Hyper's folder with favourites, an optional global bookmarks folder and one space. Keys: `hyper`, `favourites`, `globalBookmarks`, `spaces`, `space`, `spaceTabs` and `spaceBookmarks`, besides any keys in the given children. |
| `seedHyperSpace(worker, options)` | Seeds `hyperSeed(options)` and returns its keyed IDs. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/extension.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `isHyperWorker(worker)` | Whether a service worker is Hyper's background script, identified by its URL ending in background.js. |
| `launchExtension(userDataDir, { args, channel, closeInitialPage, extensionPath, extraExtensionPaths, workerTimeout, ...options })` | Starts a plain headless Chromium with Hyper loaded, and its service worker. |
| `launchHyper(userDataDir, { args, enableAudio, restoreLastSession, viewport, ...options })` | Starts Chromium (or `HYPER_E2E_CHANNEL`, headed) with Hyper and the space-race fixture pages, and opens the sidebar in a pinned tab once Hyper has built a space's bookmarks root. |
| `withUserDataDir(name, run)` | A fresh user data directory named for the test, removed once `run` settles. |
| `removeUserDataDir(path)` | Removes a browser's user data directory, or a folder holding one. The browser's helper processes can still be writing to it just after it closes. |
| `onProfile(userDataDir, run)` | Runs `run` with launchers for `userDataDir`, closing the newest browser they started once it settles. |
| `withProfile(name, run)` | Runs `run` on a fresh profile named for the test, removing it afterwards. |
| `withExtension(name, run, options)` | Runs `run` against a fresh browser from `launchExtension`, closing it afterwards. |
| `withHyper(name, run, options)` | Runs `run` against a fresh browser from `launchHyper`, closing it afterwards. |
| `extensionBaseUrl(worker)` | The extension origin URL derived from the service worker's URL, used to build URLs for extension pages. |
| `sidepanelUrl(worker)` | The full URL of the extension's sidepanel page, so tests can open the sidebar in an ordinary tab. |
| `openSidepanel(target, worker, viewport, goto)` | Opens the sidebar in `target`, or in a new tab of a context, sized first when a viewport is given. |
| `openPageSearch(webpage)` | Presses the Search shortcut in a web page that has focus and returns the in-page Search frame once it opens. |
| `openPlainSidebar(context, worker)` | Turns autofolders off and opens a 720x900 sidebar tab once its one space shows. Returns the tab and its window. |
| `titledPage(title)` | A minimal HTML document whose only content is the given title, for routed test pages. |
| `routeHtml(context, url, body)` | Answers every request matching `url` with the given HTML, or the HTML for the requested URL. |
| `routeLinkPage(context, url, title, target)` | Answers every request matching `url` with a page linking to `target` in the same tab (#same) and a new one (#new). |
| `routePathTitles(context, url, prefix)` | Answers every request matching `url` with a page titled by its path, after `prefix`. |
| `openExtensionsInDeveloperMode(context)` | Chromium disables an unpacked extension that reloads while developer mode is off, and anyone who loads Hyper unpacked has it on. |
| `nextHyperWorker(context, worker, timeout)` | The Hyper worker that starts after `worker`, as a reload or re-enable starts one. |
| `openRestartedSidepanel(context, baseUrl, goto)` | Opens the sidebar in a new tab, retrying for 10s while Hyper restarts and its pages cannot load yet. |
| `reloadHyperExtension(context, worker)` | Reloads Hyper through the developer-mode extensions page and returns the restarted sidepanel page and service worker, reporting the item state if reload fails. |
| `reenableHyperExtension(context, worker, whileDisabled)` | Disables then re-enables Hyper on the extensions page, optionally running a callback while disabled, and returns the restarted sidepanel page and worker. |
| `pinExtensionHost(worker, baseUrl)` | Pins the tab hosting the sidepanel page so it stays out of space tab handling, throwing if no such tab exists. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/extensionGlobal.ts`

### `tests/e2e/helpers/media.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `exposeMotionTabsAsAudible(page, worker)` | Headless Chromium never reports a tab as audible, so the tab query the model reads is answered as though the motion page were playing. The query is in the service worker while the tab event the sidebar listens for is in the panel, so a simulated change has to reach both. |
| `setMotionTabAudible(page, worker, audible, tabId)` | Sets a motion fixture tab's audible state in the background and dispatches the matching tab update to the page, so audio indicators animate. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/motion.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `createMotionFixture(worker)` | Waits for Hyper's bookmark structure, then seeds two spaces, nested bookmark folders and open tabs, returning their IDs for motion tests. |
| `launchMotionFixture(profile, title, options)` | Launches Chromium, opens a 900px square page, serves `title` for the motion hosts and creates the two-space motion fixture. |
| `createSecondSpaceSharedBookmark(worker, fixture)` | Bookmarks belong to spaces, so this gives the second space its own copy of the shared page, returning its ID. |
| `settleMotionFixture(worker, fixture)` | At launch the background repairs its own canonical hyper bookmark structure - including a default "Space 1" - which races with a fixture that writes spaces directly. |
| `sampleSpaceSwitch(page, bookmarkId)` | Clicks the second space's pagination dot and samples bookmark, strip and tab layer positions every frame for 420ms to measure the space transition. |
| `sampleCompactViewSwitch(page, target)` | Clicks the tabs or bookmarks trigger and samples panel counts and row animation names every frame for 340ms during the compact view switch. |
| `sampleSettingsTransition(page, action)` | Opens or closes settings and samples the settings layer position and backdrop opacity every frame for 340ms. |
| `sampleSearchMorph(page, action)` | Clicks the search action and samples the search shell's visible width, action edge and results position every frame for 340ms during the morph. |
| `isMonotonic(values, direction, tolerance)` | Whether the sampled values only increase or only decrease, allowing small reversals within the given tolerance. |
| `sampleHighlightEntry(highlight)` | Samples a hover highlight's horizontal scale for 220ms, starting immediately. |
| `startHighlightExitSampling(highlight)` | Records a hover highlight every frame until it leaves the DOM; read with highlightExitSamples. |
| `highlightExitSamples(page)` | The pagination highlight exit samples the page recorded on its global, or an empty list when none were recorded. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/permissions.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `recordPermissionRequests(worker)` | Records each permission request the background makes while still passing it to Chrome. Chrome refuses a request made outside a user gesture at once, so the outcome tells whether the press still counted as one. A request that does reach Chrome's prompt stays pending, because a headless browser cannot answer it. |
| `settledPermissionRequests(worker, graceMs)` | The recorded requests once each has had a moment to settle. Chrome answers a request outside a gesture within milliseconds, so one still pending after the grace period is waiting on Chrome's prompt. |
| `permissionRequests(worker)` | The recorded requests as they stand, pending or not. |

| --- | --- |
| `movePointerToCenter(page, target, message)` | Moves the pointer in 8 steps to the centre of a target, failing with `message` if it has no box. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/restoration.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `hyperMetadata(title)` | The hyper metadata object parsed from a bookmark title, or undefined when the title carries none. |
| `createBookmarkOnlyBacking(worker, templateUrl, url)` | Creates a tab backing bookmark copied from an existing backing's metadata but with a new token and URL, simulating a backing whose tab is gone. |
| `restorationState(worker, fixture)` | Snapshots backing bookmark counts per space, native tab groups and the window's tabs with their ownership, for asserting session restoration. |
| `nativeTabBackingState(worker, tabId, url, backingId)` | Summarizes a tab's ownership, its backing bookmark metadata, its group and position, and every tab open at the given URL. |
| `recoveryTargetCounts(state, urls)` | Counts how many tabs in the restoration snapshot are open at each recovery URL, to catch duplicated or missing restored tabs. |
| `targetCounts(state)` | Counts how many tabs in the restoration snapshot are open at the first and second fixture URLs. |
| `restorationCounts(worker, fixture, counts)` | Backings per space and open tabs per URL, which every restoration race must keep at one each. |
| `ownedTabCount(state, urls, spaceId)` | Tabs at one of `urls` that are owned by `spaceId`. |
| `recoveryTabSignature(state, urls)` | A stable JSON signature of the tabs at the recovery URLs with their IDs, groups and owning spaces, sorted by URL for comparison. |
| `expectActiveTabInSpace(state, spaceId)` | Asserts that the snapshot's active tab is owned by the given space and sits in a native tab group. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/sidebar.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `pressAndLift(page, source)` | Presses the middle of `source` and lifts it to 12px above its top edge. |
| `dragWithPointer(page, source, target, shownOn)` | `shownOn` names where the drop shows when the target does not show it itself: a list's add row is not a drop target, so a drop over it shows after the last row. |
| `backedTabRow(page, url)` | The backed tab row showing `url`, leaving out a stand-in row for an unbacked tab. |
| `tabUrlSuffixOrder(page, prefix)` | The last character of each listed tab's URL under `prefix`, in list order. |
| `pressAndPull(page, handle, steps, pull)` | Presses the middle of a drag handle and pulls it `pull` px down (up when negative), far enough to start dragging. |
| `liftTabRow(page, row)` | Presses on a settled tab row and pulls it far enough to start dragging. |
| `beginPointerDrag(page, source)` | Hovers, presses and lifts a sidebar row to start a pointer drag, then asserts the drag-mode pagination with trash target is showing. |
| `dragMarqueeSelection(page, surface, firstRow, lastRow, options)` | Drags a selection marquee across a surface covering the given rows, optionally from the right edge or with a modifier held. |
| `clickSelectionWithModifierReleased(page, target)` | Clicks a target with the platform modifier held on press but released before pointer up, reproducing a quick modifier-click selection. |
| `tabOrder(page, trackedTabIds, backedOnly)` | The tracked tab IDs in the order their rows render in the sidebar, optionally skipping rows for unsupported unbacked tabs. |
| `renderedTabOrder(page, trackedTabIds)` | The tracked tab IDs in the order the sidebar renders their rows, including rows without a backing. |
| `backedTabOrder(page, trackedTabIds)` | The tracked tabs whose rows stand for their bookmarks, in list order. A tab opened a moment ago has a row before its bookmark exists, and only the bookmark's place in the list lasts. |
| `dragTabRowBefore(page, sourceTabId, targetTabId)` | Drops one tab row on the top edge of another, so it lands just before it. Like a person, it presses the row once the row takes the press (a row that just opened is still growing into place), and lets go once the drop line shows above the target. |
| `answerNotice(page, status, button, icon)` | Expects the one header message to read `status`, then answers it with `button`, drawn as the `icon` class. |
| `spaceDot(page, title)` | The pagination dot that opens the space with this title. |
| `spaceDotById(scope, spaceId)` | The pagination dot for the space with this ID, located within the given page or element. |
| `selectSpace(page, title)` | Clicks the titled space's pagination dot, waits for it to become current and for activation work to settle. |
| `dragBookmarkToScopeTarget(page, source, target, pickUpSteps)` | Picks up an enabled bookmark row and drops it on a scope target such as a space dot, checking the target highlights before release. |
| `dragSpaceToPaginationTarget(page, title, targetSelector)` | Drags a space's pagination dot onto another dot or the trash, asserting overlay styling and insert or hover feedback along the way. |
| `spaceDotTitles(page)` | A dot's tooltip names its shortcut after the title, as in "Space 1 (⌥1)". |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/spaces.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionValues(worker, keys)` | Reads the given keys from the extension's session storage through the service worker. |
| `waitForTabSpaceGroup(worker, tabId, spaceId)` | Polls until the tab sits in a native group that session storage records as the space's group, then waits for activation to settle. |
| `routeTabThroughGroupChange(worker, tabId, spaceId)` | Marks a tab as owned by a space and moves it into a fresh native group, then waits until the background claims that group. |
| `spacesFolder(worker)` | The spaces folder inside Hyper's root bookmark folder, or undefined before the extension has created it. |
| `createSecondSpace(worker)` | Adds a second space folder beside the initialized first space and returns both space IDs with the current window ID. |
| `createExtraSpaces(worker, count)` | Adds the given number of numbered overflow space folders to the spaces folder, for tests that need many spaces. |
| `spaceGroupIds(worker, windowId, spaceIds)` | The stored native group of each space in the window, by space ID. |
| `spaceAndGroupOrder(worker, fixture)` | The space bookmark order alongside the order of the spaces' native tab groups in the window, to compare the two orderings. |
| `moveSpaceGroupBefore(worker, fixture, sourceSpaceId, targetSpaceId)` | Moves the source space's native tab group to the index of the target space's group, simulating a user reorder in the tab strip. |
| `spaceIdByTitle(worker, title)` | The bookmark ID of the first node whose visible title matches, or undefined when no such space exists. |
| `spaceLastActiveTabToken(worker, spaceId, windowId)` | The last active tab token stored in a space's bookmark metadata, per window when a window ID is given, or undefined. |
| `setSpaceLastActiveTabToken(worker, spaceId, token, windowId)` | Rewrites a space's bookmark title to record the given last active tab token, optionally for one window. |
| `createTwoSpacesWithTabs(page, worker)` | Opens a tab in Space 1, creates Second space and opens a tab there, leaving Second space shown. |
| `createSecondSpaceAfterRecoveryTabs(worker)` | Opens the first space's recovery tabs, then creates Second space once Space 1 owns them all. |

### `tests/e2e/helpers/tabs.ts`

| Function | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `resetRecordedTabLifecycle(worker)` | Clears the tab created, removed and updated events the background has recorded, so a test observes only later events. |
| `recordedTabLifecycle(worker)` | The tab created, removed and updated events the background has recorded on its global since the last reset. |
| `clearHyperRuntimeOwnership(worker)` | Removes every tab's stored space ownership value and clears session storage, simulating lost runtime state. |
| `transientCreatedTabs(lifecycle)` | The recorded created tabs that were later removed, excluding extensions page control tabs, to detect flashed tabs. |
| `createTab(worker, url, properties)` | Opens a tab, active unless told otherwise, and returns its ID. |
| `createTabs(worker, urls, properties)` | Opens the tabs one after another in a single evaluation and returns their IDs. |
| `queryTabs(worker, query)` | The browser tabs matching the query as chrome.tabs.query reports them, all tabs by default. |
| `browserTab(worker, tabId)` | A browser tab as `chrome.tabs.get` reports it. |
| `activateTab(worker, tabId)` | Makes the tab with this ID the active tab in its window through the browser API. |
| `closeWindow(worker, windowId)` | Closes the browser window with this ID through the browser API. |
| `openTabIds(worker, tabIds)` | The subset of `tabIds` that still exist, in the given order. |
| `byIndex(tabs)` | A copy of the tabs sorted by their position in the tab strip. |
| `tabUrl(worker, tabId)` | The tab's pending URL, or its committed URL once navigation has finished. |
| `openTabUrls(worker)` | Every open tab's URL, pending or committed, across windows. |
| `tabsUnder(worker, prefix)` | The tabs, across windows, whose pending or committed URL starts with `prefix`. |
| `navigateTab(worker, tabId, url)` | Navigates the tab with this ID to the given URL through the browser API. |
| `nativeTabOrder(worker, tabIds)` | The tracked tabs in the order the browser's own tab strip of the first one's window shows them. |
| `waitForTabsComplete(worker, tabIds)` | Waits until every given tab has finished loading. |
| `pageAtUrl(context, url)` | Waits for a browser page at exactly this URL and returns it, throwing if it disappears before lookup. |
| `waitForNewPage(context, action)` | Runs an action and returns the first page it opens that did not exist beforehand. |
| `navigationState(worker, trackedTabIds)` | The current window's active tab, plus the tracked tabs in strip order with their pending or committed URLs. |
| `activeTabId(worker)` | The active tab of the browser's current window. |
| `currentWindowTabIds(worker)` | The IDs of the current window's tabs in tab strip order. |
| `matchingTabState(worker, url)` | The current window's active tab ID and the IDs of its tabs open at the given URL, to detect duplicates. |
| `storedTabRecords(worker, tabIds)` | Each tab's space record as its session value and as the session storage cache hold it. |
| `tabOwnership(worker, tabIds)` | Each tab's stored space record, its session value else the session storage cache. |
| `storedTabSpaces(worker, tabIds)` | Each tab's stored space and backing token, each from its session value or else the session storage cache. |
| `tabOwnershipSummary(worker, trackedTabIds)` | Whether every tracked tab has a stored owning space, and how many distinct spaces own them. |
| `currentWindowId(worker)` | The ID of the browser's current window, throwing when the browser reports none. |
| `tabBackingToken(worker, tabId)` | The backing token stored for the tab's space ownership, or undefined when it has none. |
| `holdTabDrag(worker, dragging)` | Plays the browser's part in a tab drag: while one lasts, no extension can edit a tab strip. |
| `pageTabWindows(worker, urls)` | For each URL, the window IDs of every tab open at it, to check which windows hold each page. |
